description: Publish a small website the assistant wrote (index.html plus optional about, services, pricing, gallery, faq, contact .html and styles.css) into the public_html of the chosen domain (one hosting account can hold several, each with its own site). Content is checked and sanitised like Spark sites; existing index and same-named files are copied to a gh-backup folder first, nothing is deleted. No Spark charge. Give files, or read them from a bucket folder with storage_*. Needs confirm: true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

domain.description: Which domain gets the site: the main domain or any other domain on that hosting account (each has its own public_html). Without service_id, the account holding it is found.

files.description: Site files. Allowed names: index.html, about.html, services.html, pricing.html, gallery.html, faq.html, contact.html, styles.css.

service_id.description: Hosting service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

storage_prefix.description: Bucket folder that holds the site files, e.g. "sites/example.com/".

storage_service_id.description: Object Storage service (only when reading the files from a bucket) id, as returned by the matching list tool.

name: spark_publish_site
title: Publish a website to hosting
